links.outcome: Reproducibility of ChatGPT dental age estimates across repeated runs (ICC)
links.effect: ChatGPT showed moderate intra-observer agreement (ICC = 0.703) versus excellent for the London Atlas (ICC = 0.960); inconsistent predictions across repeated evaluations.
links.quote: The LA demonstrated fewer discrepancies and excellent reproducibility (ICC = 0.960) as compared with the moderate agreement of ChatGPT (ICC = 0.703).

links.outcome: Accuracy (MAE, RMSE) of ChatGPT versus London Atlas method on same images
links.effect: ChatGPT had higher MAE and RMSE than the London Atlas, indicating lower accuracy and greater variability; errors were largest in 6-, 12-, and 13-year-olds.
links.quote: Compared with the LA, ChatGPT exhibited higher MAE and RMSE values, indicating lower predictive accuracy and greater variability.

screen.reason: This empirical study evaluates the diagnostic accuracy and reproducibility of GPT-4o on dental age estimation using panoramic radiographs compared to human evaluation. It benchmarks performance and stability without testing a deployment guardrail or practice.
